use_capture_fixture: use the capture pytest fixture to capture and compare stdout output in pybind11 tests
use_doc_fixture: use the doc pytest fixture to sanitize and compare pybind11 module docstrings
use_msg_fixture: use the msg pytest fixture to sanitize and compare exception messages in tests
use_suppress_context_manager: use the suppress context manager to ignore expected exceptions during pybind11 test execution
use_gc_collect: use gc_collect to run the garbage collector twice for reference counting tests with PyPy
